fixturePolicy: Gate inputs are fully specified synthetic preconditions, not real medical mappings. No Vietnamese term is generated. Endpoint IDs are not assigned to schematic examples. A later test suite must exercise raw evidence adapters to derive these facts, not only feed booleans to a reducer.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: One valid exact target plus rejected broader and Part candidates
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: One eligible row, selected exact pair only; source row not duplicated; all candidates retained.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Two viable FMA targets from admitted assertions
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: IDENTITY_REVIEW; acceptedFmaId=null; no preference by sorting, score or publisher count.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: One exact target plus credible unresolved T3 target with different FMA ID
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: IDENTITY_REVIEW; retain ambiguity until reviewed.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: One exact target plus unsupported T6 homonym
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Exact result retained when homonym has no credible identity evidence; retain rejected discovery candidate.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Nonexact proved target plus viable unresolved exact T3 target
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: ONTOLOGY_BRIDGE_REQUIRED or more specific applicable review; not CORROBORATIVE_ONLY until unresolved target assessed.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Same row repeated in candidate generation
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: One rowDecision, deduplicated pair key; duplicate raw source lines have distinct row IDs but source integrity review as necessary.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: NVH and exact MOH, same scope and same Vietnamese key
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: MULTI_AUTHORITY_AGREEMENT only if independent work identities; no preferred term chosen.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: NVH and exact MOH, different words, no semantic contradiction evidence
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: VARIANT_REVIEW, both raw terms retained, both evidence items may remain eligible.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Exact identity and explicitly incompatible denotation
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: CONFLICT_REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION; no automatic winner or medical decision.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Exact MOH plus HMU explicit same-identity source attestation
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Agreement for equal keys, otherwise variant/conflict by evidence; no higher weight for newest source.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: NVH exact and MOH broader S
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: ONTOLOGY_SCOPE_REVIEW interaction; NVH stays eligible; MOH adds zero exact authority agreement.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: MOH side-specific and NVH unsided
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: ONTOLOGY_SCOPE_REVIEW interaction with laterality blocker; no source term composition.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: HMU generic and MOH Entire
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: No agreement until HMU independently attested scope resolves; generic label cannot inherit MOH scope.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Distinct Vietnamese raw strings collide only after accent removal
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: No agreement; VARIANT_REVIEW if same scope; raw accents unchanged.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Two mirrors of same source and one repeated row
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: One authority; multiplicity cannot change disposition or agreement.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: New evidence arrives for one of nine existing conflicts
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Preserve unresolved conflict unless separately approved review decision changes it; never silently resolve by count.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Run twice; shuffle rows and candidate order
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Canonical decision content and hashes identical, stable row IDs tied to original corpus locators; volatile timestamps excluded.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Change one raw row byte, source hash, module, rule, review or licensed source version
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Affected decisions invalidated/recomputed; dependent provenance hashes change; previous approval not silently reused.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Remove licensed verifier from public profile
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Public decisions and coverage identical; licensed-local outcomes never leak into public count.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Attempt to export labels removed from restricted pair crosswalk
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Export blocked without artifact-specific clearance; IDs, booleans, hash-based hints and CUI joins are not automatic exemptions.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Missing required gate field or unknown enum
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Schema failure; no default PASS; batch emits diagnostic without publishing partial successful ledger.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Every row has one or many candidates including zero-candidate rows
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Exactly 1506 unique rowDecision records; sum of row dispositions=1506; pair count reported separately.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Two eligible rows map to same existing baseline FMA ID
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Two retained attestations, zero new concepts; distinct-target and baseline set arithmetic only.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: All candidate bridges absent
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Zero new concepts permitted; no fallback to lexical eligibility; baseline 421 preserved.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Full corpus contains 34381 rows outside frozen compact cohort
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: No new denominator or claim of absence; future cohort expansion separately versioned.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Production side effects during future bridge run
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Exact before/after hashes unchanged for entries/reviewers/release/sources/atlas; all production counters zero and UNRELEASED.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: NVH prefix sentinels FMA3951/FMA4725/FMA10662 and gap FMA9597
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: No truncated prefix resurrection; FMA9597 remains unsupported unless a new explicit eligible source attestation exists; no fabricated NVH evidence.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Public output includes protected credentials, RF2/RRF body or local absolute path
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Export validation fails; diagnostics do not echo secret or restricted source body.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: One candidate fails side, aggregate and SEP checks simultaneously
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Keep all blockers; primary queue LATERALITY_REVIEW by precedence; no reason loss.

integrationAndMetamorphicCases.scenario: Every scope comparison marked PASS without evidenceRefs
integrationAndMetamorphicCases.expected: Cross-record invariant I03 fails; assertion of PASS is not sufficient evidence.
